title: Final Solution
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for x_{(1)} must be correctly stated with appropriate terms included.

title: Zero-order Solution
description: Important Criteria: The zero-order solution x_{(0)} must be correctly derived and expressed.

title: First-order Form
description: Important Criteria: The form of the first-order solution x_{(1)} must correctly incorporate the perturbation parameter lambda.

title: Initial Condition Application
description: Important Criteria: The application of the initial condition x = 0 at t = 0 must be correctly handled to find constants.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing or incorrect signs in the equations of motion or while applying the initial conditions will lead to significant errors.
